tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page. Warm paper in light, near-black in dark. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, citron-deep, vermilion, teal.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, metric tiles. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Hours outside the template, side rail, baseline weeks. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on every paper and tint. Also the fill of the main action button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Times, notes, hints on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken; 5.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of controls, cards and hard events; hatching. 3:1 or more on every paper.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative hour and day rules in the calendar only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: citron
tokens.usage: The signature. Fill of New task, 'As planned', 'Undo all', the selected tab and rail marker, today's date and the now label. Text on it: on-citron only. Never a thin line or text colour: it is too light on paper.

tokens.name: on-citron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on citron, 12:1.

tokens.name: citron-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of planned blocks. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: citron-deep
tokens.usage: Start-edge bar of planned blocks and the proposed-block dash; 3:1 or more on citron-tint and paper.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the main action button (one per area).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action.

tokens.name: busy
tokens.usage: Hard events from Google Calendar, under line-coloured hatching. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Missed blocks and error text on paper and vermilion-tint. Always with the word and the ⊘ icon.

tokens.name: vermilion-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of missed blocks and error banners. Text on it: vermilion, ink.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Confirmed and saved states on paper and teal-tint, with ✓. Sits on the blue side so it never relies on red versus green.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of success messages. Text on it: teal, ink.

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Urgency suggestions and notices. Text on it: amber-ink.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text on amber-tint, 7:1 or more.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Main ink button on hover.

tokens.name: action-press
tokens.usage: Main ink button while pressed.

tokens.name: citron-hover
tokens.usage: Citron fills on hover. Text stays on-citron.

tokens.name: citron-press
tokens.usage: Citron fills while pressed.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover background for secondary, ghost and icon buttons, nav items, rows. Text keeps its colour.

tokens.name: wash-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed background for the same controls.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. Ink in light, citron in dark; 3:1 or more on every paper.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and first setup only.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per screen: the date range, 'Check in · 2 left', 'Metrics'.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The number in a metric tile.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps 1/l/I and 0/O apart.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Block titles, notes, hints. The 14px floor for block text.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Labels under tab-bar and rail icons only.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Every clock time and duration: block times, hour labels, 'Took 1 h 20'.

styles.name: hour
styles.usage: Hour labels in the calendar gutter and the now label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; block padding, vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Block padding, horizontal.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Blocks and hard events.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, tiles, the Undo message.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip and segmented control.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest interactive element.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: New task, the four Check in options, tabs, list rows.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Start-edge bar of planned blocks.

tokens.name: hour
tokens.usage: Height of one hour in the calendar.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Width of the calendar's hour gutter.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the side rail on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Width of the side panel beside the calendar on desktop.
